Name: Sounds of Rain
Author: MissCoriel
TagLine: During rainy days, all you are given is just a rain track.  This music pack adds 3 possible songs over that.  Rainy days don't have to be quiet.
Description:
Stardew Valley uses a SFX looping track for raining.  If you feel this effect is far too quiet, why not add some music for the rain days?!
The Sounds of Rain, like other music packs, contains handcrafted songs (with a rain track within it).  Each rainy day, it will choose between three different songs.
[soundcloud]https://soundcloud.com/evilpickle-music-dept/sets/sounds-of-rain[/soundcloud]

Fixed it to where it consistently works :D

Installation is easy

1.  Install SMAPI

2.  Install Custom Music

3.  Place this mod in the  mods folder.
